card.title: Night Bus
card.instruments: hammond organ, brushed drums, upright bass
card.lyrics:
[verse]
Empty seats and a wet windscreen
Every stop is mine tonight
[chorus]
Let the city keep its noise
I have got the quiet side
Let the city keep its noise
I am happy on this ride
card.note: Written SPARSE on purpose. Sung recall measured 92% on gospel (organ, claps, space) against 0% on arena rock (walls of distorted guitar in the voice's own range), and thinning neon_saturday took it from 5% to 68%. Few instruments, room around the voice, vocal named once.

tags_sent: sparse soul, hammond organ, brushed drums, upright bass, calm, solitary, clear male lead vocal
